mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has risen from +2.0 to +4.0 over the last four weeks, marking normalization of household errands. This errand recovery spills over into adjacent discretionary retail trips, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is below its last-28-day mean whenever GROCERY_PHARM is above +3.5 at decision time.

mechanism_narrative: A TRANSIT weekly mean below -25 percent signals severe avoidance of shared mobility and correlates with depressed discretionary trips. When TRANSIT crosses below -25, RETAIL_REC remains suppressed for the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean crosses below -25 percent
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite TRANSIT remaining below -25 percent at the decision time point.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS falls below -15 percent while RESIDENTIAL stays above +3 percent, households are confining activity to home. This home-confinement suppresses retail-and-recreation footfall over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 4 weeks exceeds last 4 weeks when both PARKS < -15 and RESIDENTIAL > +3 hold at the decision time point.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime with persistent remote work, WORKPLACES improvement above -7.5 for two weeks signals returning commuting and office-adjacent spending. This lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to its last-28-day mean when WORKPLACES exceeds -7.5 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL remaining above +3.3 percent indicates sustained voluntary or mandated staying at home. This behavioral caution keeps discretionary retail trips depressed over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 4 weeks is higher than last 4 weeks while RESIDENTIAL remains above +3.3 at the decision time point.

mechanism_narrative: The sharp PARKS drop to -25.9 in t-1w is a transient weather or reporting anomaly. A spring rebound above -10 in the next two weeks restores outdoor recreation and lifts nearby retail-and-recreation activity.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -10 after a week below -20
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next 28 days when PARKS rebounds above -10 after a week below -20.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated GROCERY_PHARM above +3.5 combined with depressed WORKPLACES below -8.0 indicates essential-trip substitution for office-based routines. As grocery demand peaks, retail-and-recreation recovers over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 4 weeks is lower than last 4 weeks when GROCERY_PHARM > +3.5 and WORKPLACES < -8.0 at the decision time point.

mechanism_narrative: Easing restrictions first shows up in TRANSIT as riders return to shared mobility. When TRANSIT crosses above -23 percent, policy relaxation is broad enough to lift RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean crosses above -23 percent
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than its last-28-day mean when TRANSIT crosses above -23 percent.
